defs.meaning: [军]坦克；贮水池；大容器（tank 的复数）
把……储在容器；打败；乘坦克行进（tank 的三单形式）

examples.en: Tanks raise huge trails of dust when they move.
examples.zh: 坦克移动时掀起滚滚的尘土。

examples.en: Tanks have been deployed all along the front line.
examples.zh: 沿整个前线已部署了坦克。

examples.en: The tanks were mainly constructed of steel plates.
examples.zh: 这些坦克车主要是用钢板制造的。
